[IDAT.7.2] Tagged union: consumers switch on `kind` and access
the matching union member (`ev->p.fact_assert.fact`,
`ev->p.rule_fire_end.timetag`, …). Compiler-checked
access; no `void *` casts. Struct size is bounded by
the largest variant; every
event pays that size regardless of kind, but events
flow through the recorder and do not accumulate.
